print('run', {k:x[k] for k in ['revision','device','seed','torch_version','python_version','step_scale']})
print('training',{k:r['training'][k] for k in ['steps','planned_steps','records','records_sha256','parameters','effective_tokens']})
print('split',r['split'])

print('artifact_names',x['artifacts'])
for mode in ['correct_with_distractor','distractor_only']:
 print('mode',mode,'metrics',{k:r['metrics'][mode][k] for k in ['citation_valid','supported_by_cited_source','fact_answer_correct','exact_match','unknown']})
 for row in r['samples']:
  if row['mode']==mode:
   print(json.dumps({k:row[k] for k in ['family','fact','documents','expected','parsed_address','parsed_citation','citation_valid','supported_by_cited_source','fact_answer_correct','exact_match','unknown']}|{'generated':row['generation']['samples'][0]['generated'],'invalid_special_tokens':row['generation']['samples'][0]['invalid_special_tokens']},ensure_ascii=False))
for path in ['docs/course-experiments/releases/rag.json','docs/course-experiments/public-releases/rag.json']:
 p=Path(path); q=json.loads(p.read_text()); print(path,hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
 if 'files' in q:
  print('revision',q['revision']);print('files',q['files']);print('inference',q['inference']);print('model_card_keys',list(q['model_card']))
 else:
  print({k:q['release'][k] for k in ['repo','revision','weights_revision','public_manifest']})
